options.content:
◉   BORANT BROADCAST NETWORK   /   EARTH SEASON 01
Crawlcast audience control
Can viewers save the crawler they came to watch?

panels.title: Viewers tuning in
panels.description: Distinct Faro sessions selecting a crawler signal per website version.

targets.expr: count by (edition) (sum by (edition, viewer) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name", route="event_data_route", viewer="session_id", ms="event_data_duration_ms" | event="crawler_opened" | viewer!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Favourite journeys
panels.description: Distinct journeys started. Retrying the same save counts once.

targets.expr: count by (edition) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name", route="event_data_route", viewer="session_id", ms="event_data_duration_ms" | event="favourite_started" | journey!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Save completion
panels.description: Percentage of started journeys completing via either route during this time window.

targets.expr: 100 * ((count by (edition) ((sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name" | event="favourite_saved" | journey!="" [$__range]))) and on (edition, journey) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name" | event="favourite_started" | journey!="" [$__range]))))) or ((count by (edition) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name" | event="favourite_started" | journey!="" [$__range])))) * 0)) / (count by (edition) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name" | event="favourite_started" | journey!="" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Affected journeys
panels.description: Distinct journeys with a failed favourite save, including those later recovered.

targets.expr: ((count by (edition) ((sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name" | event="favourite_failed" | journey!="" [$__range]))) and on (edition, journey) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name" | event="favourite_started" | journey!="" [$__range]))))) or ((count by (edition) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name" | event="favourite_started" | journey!="" [$__range])))) * 0))

panels.title: Favourite save failures over time
panels.description: Distinct affected journeys per rolling minute, split by website version.

targets.expr: (count by (edition) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name", route="event_data_route", viewer="session_id", ms="event_data_duration_ms" | event="favourite_failed" | journey!="" [1m])))) or ((count by (edition) (sum by (edition, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name", route="event_data_route", viewer="session_id", ms="event_data_duration_ms" | event="favourite_started" | journey!="" [1m])))) * 0)

panels.title: Time to favourite · p95
panels.description: From first save click to confirmed favourite. Includes retries and full-profile recovery. Only completed journeys have a duration.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name", route="event_data_route", viewer="session_id", ms="event_data_duration_ms" | event="favourite_saved" | unwrap ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (edition)

panels.title: Where viewers finish saving
panels.description: Completed journeys by website version and save route.

targets.expr: count by (path) (sum by (path, journey) (count_over_time({service_name="borant-broadcast"} | json edition="event_data_site_version", journey="event_data_journey", event="event_name", route="event_data_route" | event="favourite_saved" | journey!="" | label_format path=`{{.edition}} / {{.route}}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Viewer session · event timeline
panels.description: The website link selects one Faro session. Clear the session field to see all viewers. Expand an error for its browser stack.

targets.expr: {service_name="borant-broadcast"} |= "$session" | json | event_domain="broadcast" or kind="exception" | line_format `{{if eq .kind "exception"}}ERROR · {{.context_site_version}} · {{.value}}{{else}}{{.event_data_site_version}} · {{.event_name}} · {{.event_data_crawler}} {{.event_data_route}} {{.event_data_reason}} · {{.event_data_scene}}{{end}}`
